sharedRules.name: Anomalous Way-Seers
sharedRules.description:
Whenever this unit would enter the range of an Anomaly entity, it ignores any special rules or penalties that would be triggered.


Ex. The Flashing Dodger anomaly would not inflict 1 damage to any Pioneer models within it's 6 inch radius.
